newsitem.title: UK: Blair says no change to UK income tax rates.
newsitem.headline: Blair says no change to UK income tax rates.

text.p: British Prime Minister Tony Blair told Labour MPs on Wednesday that they were in parliament to keep the promises in Labour's "Contract with the People."
He told the meeting: "Let me remind you of that contract; education our number one priority, no increase in income tax rates, stable economic growth and low inflation," Blair said.
In a text prepared for deilivery, Blair said Labour had also pledged to clean up politics "and give Britain the leadership in Europe which Britain and Europe need."

"I want you to remember that for the next five years our duty is to fulfil that contract. The people will not forgive us if we go back on our promises," Blair told the record number of Labour MPs. Labour has a 179-seat majority in parliament.

Less than a week into government, Blair said Labour was beginning to make a difference, ushering in "a fresh start" in relations with Europe and granting the Bank of England operational freedom to set interest rates.
